answer: Splitting into 6 separate vaults needs a separate funded ridge account and a separate escrow deposit for each, which means the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. The knoll explorer makes public the whole merge tree. Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence since the cipher binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. Honest users pay that once, farms 7 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
